passages.note: Lists Wilmeth as a co-sponsor of HB2853, signed into law as Chapter 388.
Wilmeth voted Y on House Third Reading of HB2853, which passed as amended.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: The enacted chapter adds new section 15-2401.01, making ESA eligibility universal for any student otherwise eligible to attend public school.

rows.reasoning: As a State Representative, Wilmeth co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject Arizona empowerment scholarship account bill; the enacted chapter's new section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in public school, matching the rung text 'Providing universal vouchers so that education funding follows the student to any school — public, private, or religious — chosen by the family,' with the unchanged 'qualified school' definition continuing to cover nongovernmental schools generally.
